text.description_html:
Stainless Steel 4" x 16" Door Pull Plate in Matte Black

Common size door pull plate primarily used in restaurants, warehouses and stores, but are popular in homes as well. The plate is 4" wide and 16" long; and is made of .050" thick high quality stainless steel for longevity. While the grip is 8-3/4" with a 3/4" diameter. It is made out of stainless steel with a matte black finish. Packaged with matching finish mounting screws for easy installation.

Also Available: Matching Matte Black 4" x 16" Push Plate

Specifications of the Matte Black Stainless Steel Door Pull Plate:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Matte Black
  • Plate Height: 16"
  • Plate Width: 4"
  • Plate Thickness: .050" (1.2 mm)
  • Pull Handle Length: 8-3/4"
  • Pull Handle Diameter: 3/4"
  • Packaged with mounting screws.

Sold Individually
